ios.desc:
From the creator of Polychord, comes Vibescape – an immersive meditation experience. 

Inspired by the stunning landscapes of the Pacific Northwest, we wanted to share that beauty with the world – and allow you to transport yourself to truly unique locations where you can clear your mind and find a moment of peace & relaxation. Version 4 goes even further, with The Void: remastered. A stark, minimalist environment that comes alive with sounds of Clair de Lune. 

Vibescape also includes a collection of spatial vignettes filmed on location at our nature conservation project at Clery Farm in the Willamette Valley, Oregon. Majestic oak trees, tall stands of Douglas Fir – these winter scenes come alive with snow and icy ASMR.

quotes.text:
I launched two apps for visionOS 26 this month:

Metaballs: Spatial, which is a really fun interactive sculpting app. Brand new app. Fast-follow update this week adds USDZ and STL export! https://apps.apple.com/us/app/metaballs/id6748781900

Vibescape: an immersive meditation app. This one is currently featured at the top of the App Store, yay! Launched as a day one app on Vision Pro, new update has what I think is the best immersive environment I've made yet that comes alive with music: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vibescape/id6476827678

I'm also working on the next episode of Ice Moon — a YouTube series I'm doing on how to build immersive environments for Apple Vision Pro: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHA_sJmXyiktWkqLnHEUj1k5hfQRBjBq_&si=yVZpC-oD2JAaBw3b
